title: Preserve collection-parameter translation configuration
goal: Choose constants, one collection parameter or multiple parameters when migrating collection query settings.

selectionNotes: EF10 TranslateParameterizedCollectionsToConstants maps to UseParameterizedCollectionMode(Constant); TranslateParameterizedCollectionsToParameters maps to Parameter. MultipleParameters is a distinct mode and already exists in EF10. EF11 removes the two helpers. SQL Server executes seeded Contains queries, constants and EF.Parameter overrides with identical IDs. Constant produces IN (1, 3), Parameter uses OPENJSON and one JSON parameter, MultipleParameters uses scalar parameters. OPENJSON requires SQL compatibility130+. Measured SQL2025 uses compatibility170. Each mode uses a separate internal service provider to avoid reusing a previously compiled query shape across option changes in the same process. This isolated comparison proves those configurations; dynamically changing mode on shared cached services is not established. Query-level EF.Constant/EF.Parameter overrides are checked. Parameter padding, query plans, speed and arbitrary providers are not promised.
